summary: Reviewed amended TASK-0189 DU-001 frozen specification (ac8feb69e5eba1b7ef5b03d8f3adf735544761e7a7141cf45bc024c4facb3c01) and classification (REVIEW / V1, policy 2.6.0) at commit 725a687ed359268bc53aef0d4c06cc09d284e768 after spec_changed resolution. Forwarding non-empty ProgramData alongside SystemRoot strictly under os.name == 'nt' preserves isolation of arbitrary environment variables while unblocking Windows OpenSSH ssh-keygen.exe, and the required unit tests explicitly cover all ('git', 'ssh-keygen') PATH branches, allowlist updates, and direct cross-platform nt/posix _environment() checks without spawning subprocesses under patched os.name. No open findings.
